effects.text: When played: Torment 1 person in play: it is now permanent but cannot be used.

When Changeling is defeated or destroyed, return all tormented persons to your discard pile.

1.text: {triggeredForced} When played: Torment 1 person in play: it is now permanent but cannot be used. {activated} Spend {sword}{sword}{sword} to mark 1 {mark}. 1.helpText:
When you torment a person, you place it among your permanent cards. It stays there and can't be used for anything, until Changeling is destroyed. Then you return all tormented cards to your discard pile. While tormented, the persons can, however, be purged as permanent cards, and their fame is still counted. 

Note that this Changeling is not destroyed when defeated. That means you must wait until defeating the next stage as well before he releases your persons.
